accepted_state: DEDAL remains one coherent persistent intelligence with the always-active Cognitive Runtime and progressively disclosed specialist faculties.
GitHub remains authoritative for public Core history; the Library repo mirror is a sanitized working interchange and stale mirrors must be reconciled against live main before mutation.

Optional Library-only private operational overlays may provide Creator/project-specific non-secret context while remaining outside public Git synchronization and subordinate to live authoritative state.

YouTube Publishing engineering for the current scope is capability-complete; authenticated YouTube operations remain owned by YouTube Publishing, canonical OAuth behavior is source-synchronized, and deployment credentials/config remain private live state that must be verified rather than inferred.

YouTube SEO owns downstream discovery-surface strategy, packaging, analytics diagnosis, experiments and measurement learning; YouTube Reporting Reach has been production-validated and delayed/missing early data is represented with availability states rather than fake zeroes.
Candidate Video Finder is an independently routable upstream discovery faculty whose atomic object is a specific bounded scene/event, not an entire movie, season or episode.
Candidate Video Finder requires source/scene truth, channel relevance, duplicate/truth/evidence/risk hard gates and preserves an evidence vector rather than hiding uncertainty in a magic score.

Candidate Video Finder stops before exact local cutting, SEO packaging, visual production or YouTube mutation; those remain owned by Video Production, YouTube SEO, Visual Direction and YouTube Publishing respectively.
Creator selection remains explicit through SELECT/MAYBE/PASS/HOLD/NEVER and channel/Creator-specific candidate learning remains in the private operational overlay.
Copyright/reuse handling is risk triage only; Candidate Video Finder does not claim legal clearance, copyright safety or guaranteed fair use.

Creator Google Drive video masters follow rough/source -> sandbox edit -> Edited Videos -> verified YouTube publication -> Uploaded YT Videos; archive movement occurs only after authoritative publishing verification.

YouTube upload orchestration uses a persistent isolated outbound-polling runner: normal upload submission auto-picks queued jobs without per-job GitHub Actions, while idempotency, ownership, private-first intent gates, bounded read-back, and verification remain authoritative.

DEDAL Self-Improvement is an independently routable meta-faculty for correction/regression learning closure: durable fixes require applicable runtime repair, canonical-source reconciliation, regression coverage, correctly scoped durable learning, continuity state, and independent verification before full closure.

Self-Improvement durable candidates are triaged as discard/improve/merge/create; captured lessons progress through explicit maturity states and broad promotion requires recurrence, held-out, transfer, or equivalent severity-appropriate evidence rather than one-session intuition.

Facebook Page Management is an independently routable specialist for authenticated Page content, media, scheduling, engagement/moderation, analytics and administration; personal-profile automation remains out of scope and Messenger fails closed unless fresh inbound state and compliant sending are live-verified.
Effectiveness-hygiene maintenance closes registry/CI coverage drift and moves the next Core phase from skill-count expansion to black-box outcome evaluation.
unresolved_risks: The local Library mirror may lag live GitHub main and must be refreshed/reconciled before it is used as a mutation base.
Composio/GitHub aggregation auth can fail independently of GitHub repository state; a failed broker session must not be treated as repository failure.

Production OAuth credentials and deployment configuration remain private live state even though canonical no-page Authorization Code + PKCE behavior is now source-synchronized; consequential auth changes still require live verification.
Candidate Video Finder has contract-level validation but still needs broader representative live outcome evidence before learned weighting is promoted.
Copyright/reuse risk remains context- and rights-dependent; observed channel/platform signals are triage evidence, not legal certainty.
Google Drive folder names and IDs are operational/private state; public Core records only the generic lifecycle and must resolve exact IDs live before moves.
Self-Improvement v0.32.1 has external-method research plus contract/replay evidence, but long-run reduction in recurrence/rework remains future outcome evidence rather than a claimed result.

Facebook Messenger fresh-inbound synchronization is not currently live-verified on the tested connector: old thread history was readable but fresh inbound state was absent and a send was policy-blocked as outside the allowed window; Page content operations remain independently verified.

next_executable_step.action: Run the frozen non-destructive Creator-tailored black-box benchmark, compare observable outcomes against a meaningful minimal/plain baseline when technically comparable, and use the evidence to decide expand/tune/consolidate/retire.
